pages.text: $(l)YEAR 315 AFTER ZOMBIE$()$(br2)At first, I believed the Frosted Prison might be a place where I could settle. A place where I could finally disappear. I was wrong.$(br2)Deep within its lowest dungeon, I found a creature with a heart of ice.

It had been imprisoned inside a cage of steel. I freed it. I thought perhaps it would understand me. Perhaps it would be like me. A creature that did not belong anywhere.$(br2)The moment I released it, it attacked me. I barely escaped. It drove me away as though I were nothing more than another monster.

Perhaps that is all I am now. I belong nowhere. Humans look at me as though I am a monster. Monsters look at me as though I am prey.$(br2)How long have I been wandering? How long have I searched for a place where I could finally find peace? I no longer know. I am not human anymore. I can feel it.

My limbs have become heavy. The ground seems so far beneath me now. Farther than I remember it ever being. When I look down at my hands, they no longer feel like mine. Sometimes I wonder if there is anything left of the man who once held his wife's hand. The man who dreamed of restoring the world.

The man who believed he could bring humanity back from the brink. I cannot remember his face anymore. Only the handwriting remains. Only these pages remind me that he ever existed.$(br2)Today, while hiding beneath a pile of rags in a tavern, I overheard something. A fortress.

A place that can supposedly be summoned from another world. A place untouched by the laws of this one. A fortress that could be brought here. A fortress that might finally give me what I have been searching for all these years. A home.$(br2)I left before anyone could see what was beneath the rags.

I traveled far from the nearest village. Far from people. Far from everything.$(br2)If I summon this fortress... If I bring a piece of another world into mine... will it finally accept me? Will I finally have somewhere I belong?$(br2)I do not need much. Only a talisman.

Something bound to the storm that seems to rage inside me.$(br2)And a place where no one can find me. No humans. No monsters. No one. Perhaps, if I build a place far enough from this broken world...$(br2)I can finally be alone.
Perhaps I can finally rest. Perhaps... I can finally stop running.
